```{=html}
<link rel="icon" href="/apps/patterns/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
<style>
#patterns-root { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto 1rem; padding: 0 4px; }
#patterns-root .tp-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem .75rem; align-items: center;
  background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: .5rem; padding: .6rem .75rem; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
#patterns-root .tp-bar select, #patterns-root .tp-bar input[type=number] { width: auto; height: auto; padding: .25rem .35rem; }
#patterns-root .tp-bar input[type=number] { width: 3.6rem; }
#patterns-root .tp-bar label { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .3rem; font-size: .88rem; }
#patterns-root .tp-btn { padding: .35rem .8rem; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: .375rem; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
#patterns-root .tp-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #2780e3; border-radius: .4rem; overflow: hidden; }
#patterns-root .tp-seg button { border: 0; background: #fff; color: #2780e3; padding: .35rem .8rem; cursor: pointer; }
#patterns-root .tp-seg button.on { background: #2780e3; color: #fff; }
#patterns-root .tp-gen-help { flex-basis: 100%; font-size: .8rem; color: #6c757d; }
#patterns-root .tp-gen-msg { font-size: .85rem; color: #b02a37; }
#patterns-root .tp-make { background: #2780e3; color: #fff; border-color: #2780e3; }
#patterns-root input[type=text] { padding: .25rem .4rem; max-width: 100%; }
#patterns-root .tp-more { display: none; } #patterns-root .tp-more.open { display: flex; }
#patterns-root .tp-papers { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
#patterns-root.class .tp-papers { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
#patterns-root.indiv .tp-papers { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
#patterns-root .tp-staff { border: 1px solid #e9ecef; border-radius: .4rem; padding: .25rem .4rem; background: #fff; }
#patterns-root.indiv .tp-staff:not(.sel) { display: none; }
#patterns-root.indiv .tp-staff .tp-name { display: none; }
#patterns-root .tp-name { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6c757d; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; }
#patterns-root .tp-staff svg { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; display: block; }
#patterns-root text[font-family*="Times New Roman"] { display: none; }
#patterns-root .tp-solf { display: none; text-align: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(2rem, 9vw, 7rem); line-height: 1.1; margin: .5rem 0; }
#patterns-root.hide-notes .tp-papers { display: none; }
#patterns-root .tp-indiv-only { display: none; } #patterns-root.indiv .tp-indiv-only { display: inline-flex; }
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  #patterns-root.class .tp-papers { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  #patterns-root .tp-bar { padding: .5rem; }
}
</style>

<div id="patterns-root" class="indiv">
  <div class="tp-bar">
    <span class="tp-seg" role="group" aria-label="Display">
      <button type="button" data-mode="indiv" class="on">Individual</button><button type="button" data-mode="class">Class</button>
    </span>
    <label class="tp-indiv-only">Read as
      <select id="tp-staff-pick">
        <option value="0">Concert (treble)</option><option value="1">B♭ instrument</option>
        <option value="3">E♭ instrument</option><option value="2">Bass clef</option>
      </select></label>
    <select id="pattern-selector" aria-label="Collection"></select>
    <select id="tune-selector" aria-label="Pattern"></select>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn" onclick="tpStep(-1)">◀ Prev</button>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn" onclick="tpStep(1)">Next ▶</button>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn" onclick="tpRandom()">Random</button>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-bar" id="tp-play"></div>
  <div class="tp-bar">
    <label>Key <select id="key-select"></select></label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" checked id="show-notes"> Notes</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="show-solfege"> Solfege</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="show-options"> More</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="show-gen"> Make a set</label>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-bar tp-more tp-gen" id="tp-gen">
    <label>Chords <input type="text" id="gen-chords" value="I, V7, V7/V" placeholder="i7, V7, iiø7" style="width:13rem"></label>
    <label>Mode <select id="gen-mode"></select></label>
    <span>Notes:</span>
    <label><input type="checkbox" class="gen-size" value="2" checked> 2</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" class="gen-size" value="3" checked> 3</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" class="gen-size" value="4"> 4</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" class="gen-size" value="5"> 5</label>
    <label>How many <input type="number" id="gen-count" value="16" min="2" max="64"></label>
    <label>Harmony <select id="gen-style"><option value="auto">auto</option><option value="classical">classical</option><option value="rock">rock</option></select></label>
    <label>Order <select id="gen-order"><option value="blocks">longest first</option><option value="mixed">mixed</option></select></label>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn tp-make" id="gen-make">Make set</button>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn" id="gen-again" title="Same chords, a different set">Another</button>
    <button type="button" class="tp-btn" id="gen-del" style="display:none">Delete this set</button>
    <span class="tp-gen-msg" id="gen-msg"></span>
    <div class="tp-gen-help">Harmony: classical moves I–IV–V–I and resolves 7ths; rock adds IV–I, V–IV and ♭VII–IV–I (auto picks rock when you list ♭VII, ♭III or ♭VI). Roman numerals (I ii IV V vi vii°, ♭VII or bVII, V7, ii7, iiø7, vii°7, Imaj7, V7/V) or chord symbols (Dm, A7). Written with tonic C, so the Key menu above sets the key. Sets are kept in this browser as ★ in the collection menu, on this page and on Tonal Sequences.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-bar tp-more" id="more">
    <span>Octave:</span>
    <label>Concert <input type="number" id="oct0" value="0" min="-2" max="2"></label>
    <label>B♭ <input type="number" id="oct1" value="0" min="-2" max="2"></label>
    <label>E♭ <input type="number" id="oct3" value="0" min="-2" max="2"></label>
    <label>Bass <input type="number" id="oct2" value="0" min="-2" max="2"></label>
  </div>
  <p class="tp-solf" id="solfege-display"></p>
  <div class="tp-papers">
    <div class="tp-staff sel" data-i="0"><div class="tp-name">Concert (treble)</div><div id="paper0"></div></div>
    <div class="tp-staff" data-i="1"><div class="tp-name">B♭ instruments</div><div id="paper1"></div></div>
    <div class="tp-staff" data-i="3"><div class="tp-name">E♭ instruments</div><div id="paper3"></div></div>
    <div class="tp-staff" data-i="2"><div class="tp-name">Bass clef</div><div id="paper2"></div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js?v=3"></script>
<script src="/apps/patterns/pattern-set.js?v=4"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/tonality.js?v=10"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/abc-play.js?v=6"></script>
<script src="/apps/patterns/pattern-play.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/patterns/pattern-gen.js?v=3"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById("patterns-root"), $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var abcList = [], cur = 0; var sel = $("pattern-selector");
  // Each staff: base transposition (written C = middle C), clef. Concert treble shows an octave up, as before.
  var STAFF = [{ t: 12 }, { t: 2 }, { t: -12, bass: true }, { t: 9 }];
  var KEYS = ["C", "D♭", "D", "E♭", "E", "F", "G♭", "G", "A♭", "A", "B♭", "B"];
  KEYS.forEach(function (k, i) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = i; o.textContent = k; $("key-select").appendChild(o); });
  var semis = function () { var r = +$("key-select").value; return r <= 6 ? r : r - 12; };

  function setMode(m) {
    root.classList.toggle("indiv", m === "indiv"); root.classList.toggle("class", m === "class");
    root.querySelectorAll(".tp-seg button").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.mode === m); });
    try { localStorage.setItem("tp-mode", m); } catch (e) {}
    render();
  }
  root.querySelectorAll(".tp-seg button").forEach(function (b) { b.onclick = function () { setMode(b.dataset.mode); }; });
  $("tp-staff-pick").onchange = function () {
    root.querySelectorAll(".tp-staff").forEach(function (s) { s.classList.toggle("sel", s.dataset.i === $("tp-staff-pick").value); });
    try { localStorage.setItem("tp-staff", $("tp-staff-pick").value); } catch (e) {}
    render();
  };

  function refreshSongbook() {
    var book = new ABCJS.TuneBook(patternObject[$("pattern-selector").value]);
    abcList = book.tunes.map(function (t) { return t.abc; });
    $("tune-selector").innerHTML = book.tunes.map(function (t, i) { return '<option value="' + i + '">' + (i + 1) + '</option>'; }).join("");
    cur = 0; render();
  }
  window.refreshSongbook = refreshSongbook;
  function go(i) { if (!abcList.length) return; cur = (i + abcList.length) % abcList.length; $("tune-selector").value = cur; player.stop(); render(); }
  window.tpStep = function (d) { go(cur + d); };
  window.tpRandom = function () { if (abcList.length < 2) return; var i; do { i = Math.floor(Math.random() * abcList.length); } while (i === cur); go(i); };

  function render() {
    var tune = abcList[cur]; if (!tune) return;
    var m = tune.match(/^w:\s?(.*)$/m); $("solfege-display").textContent = m ? m[1] : "";
    var lines = tune.split("\n"); lines[0] += "\nM:none\n%%staffwidth 100"; tune = lines.join("\n");
    var indiv = root.classList.contains("indiv"), pick = +$("tp-staff-pick").value;
    STAFF.forEach(function (s, i) {
      if (indiv && i !== pick) return;                       // only draw what's on screen
      var src = s.bass ? tune.replace(/^(X:.*)$/m, "$1\nK: clef=bass") : tune;
      ABCJS.renderAbc("paper" + i, src, { responsive: "resize", selectTypes: false, add_classes: true,
        visualTranspose: s.t + semis() + 12 * (+$("oct" + i).value || 0) });
    });
  }
  window.paramChanged = render;

  var player = PatternPlay.bar($("tp-play"), { abc: function () { return abcList[cur] || ""; }, transpose: semis });

  $("tune-selector").onchange = function () { go(+this.value); };
  $("pattern-selector").onchange = function () { player.stop(); refreshSongbook(); };
  $("key-select").onchange = render;
  ["oct0", "oct1", "oct2", "oct3"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).oninput = render; });
  $("show-notes").onchange = function () { root.classList.toggle("hide-notes", !this.checked); };
  $("show-solfege").onchange = function () { $("solfege-display").style.display = this.checked ? "block" : "none"; };
  // Make a set (pattern-gen.js)
  TonalPatternGen.modes.forEach(function (m) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = o.textContent = m; $("gen-mode").appendChild(o); });
  $("show-gen").onchange = function () { $("tp-gen").classList.toggle("open", this.checked); };
  var genSeed = 1;
  function make(newSeed) {
    if (newSeed) genSeed = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6);
    var sizes = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".gen-size:checked")).map(function (b) { return +b.value; });
    var spec = { chords: $("gen-chords").value, mode: $("gen-mode").value, sizes: sizes, count: +$("gen-count").value || 16, order: $("gen-order").value, style: $("gen-style").value, seed: genSeed };
    var r;
    try { r = TonalPatternGen.generate(spec); } catch (e) { $("gen-msg").textContent = e.message; return; }
    $("gen-msg").textContent = "";
    var name = spec.chords.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "").split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean).join(" ") + " · " + spec.mode + (r.style === "rock" ? " · rock" : "") + " · " + sizes.join("/") + (genSeed > 1 ? " #" + genSeed : "");
    TonalPatternGen.save(name, spec, r.abc);
    var k = "★ " + name; patternObject[k] = r.abc;
    if (!Array.from(sel.options).some(function (o) { return o.value === k; })) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = o.textContent = k; sel.insertBefore(o, sel.firstChild); }
    sel.value = k; sel.style.display = ""; player.stop(); refreshSongbook(); showDel();
  }
  function showDel() { $("gen-del").style.display = /^★ /.test(sel.value) ? "" : "none"; }
  $("gen-make").onclick = function () { make(false); };
  $("gen-again").onclick = function () { make(true); };
  $("gen-chords").onkeydown = function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") make(false); };
  $("gen-del").onclick = function () {
    var k = sel.value; if (!/^★ /.test(k)) return;
    TonalPatternGen.remove(k.slice(2)); delete patternObject[k]; sel.querySelector('option[value="' + CSS.escape(k) + '"]').remove();
    sel.selectedIndex = 0; refreshSongbook(); showDel();
  };
  sel.addEventListener("change", showDel);

  $("show-options").onchange = function () { $("more").classList.toggle("open", this.checked); };

  if (window.TonalPatternGen) TonalPatternGen.loadSaved(patternObject);
  Object.keys(patternObject).forEach(function (k) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = o.textContent = k; sel.appendChild(o); });
  var CFG = window.TOOL_CONFIG || {};
  if (CFG.collections && CFG.collections.length) Array.from(sel.options).forEach(function (o) { if (CFG.collections.indexOf(o.value) === -1 && !/^★ /.test(o.value)) o.remove(); });
  if (CFG.lockCollections || sel.options.length <= 1) sel.style.display = "none";

  // Key dropdown = the tonal center; patterns are written with tonic C. Follows the shared tonality.
  var MINOR = /^(m|min|minor|aeo|aeolian|dor|dorian|phr|phrygian|loc|locrian)$/;
  var CP = { "major-stepwise": "minor-stepwise", "minor-stepwise": "major-stepwise", "major-I-V": "minor-i-V", "minor-i-V": "major-I-V" };
  function applyT() {
    if (!window.Tonality) return; var r = Tonality.getResting(); if (r == null) return;
    var mode = Tonality.getMode(), wantMinor = !!(mode && MINOR.test(mode));
    if (CP[sel.value] && wantMinor !== /^minor/.test(sel.value) && Array.from(sel.options).some(function (o) { return o.value === CP[sel.value]; })) { sel.value = CP[sel.value]; refreshSongbook(); }
    $("key-select").value = String(r); render();
  }
  if (window.Tonality) Tonality.onChange(function (st, src) { if (src !== "local") applyT(); });

  try {
    var sp = localStorage.getItem("tp-staff"); if (sp) { $("tp-staff-pick").value = sp; $("tp-staff-pick").onchange(); }
    var md = localStorage.getItem("tp-mode"); if (md) root.className = md;
  } catch (e) {}
  setMode(root.classList.contains("class") ? "class" : "indiv");
  refreshSongbook(); applyT();
})();
</script>
```
